bibl.title: Due lettere di A.S. Hunt a J.G. Smyly.
bibl.seg: 160 Hunt Arthur Surridge Smyly Josiah Gilbart
Natascia Pellé, Due lettere di A.S. Hunt a J.G. Smyly.
bibl.note: Provides a critical edition of two unpublished letters addressed by A.S. Hunt to J.G. Smyly about B.P. Grenfell's death and the future of the Greek papyri from Tebtynis still unpublished.
